evidence: REAL GATE IN THE GATE DIMENSIONS. tests/scoring.toml: '[gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0', weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, floor functional 0.05. Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with binary criteria. tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the template (gates suite at line 213, score.py at 217, 'exit 0' on status 1 at 220, scored suite only at 224), so a failed gate zeroes the reward and the scored suite never runs. gates/render/prompt.md line 5: 'A blank page, a generic error, an unavailable server, or a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails.' Its one criterion cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing (judge.toml line 23) requires load, a visible code editing area, a real typed word appearing in it and a successful reload. gates/constraints carries the backing leg: cw_shared_saved_record saves a snippet, clears 'this origin's browser storage', reloads twice and re-reads title, filename and source, so a client-only shell (localStorage, IndexedDB, cache, OPFS, service worker, cookies) fails; cw_custom_document_surface enforces the publicly stated editor constraint (ui.md line 3 names the same textarea/input/contenteditable ban, the same ready-made editors and the same plumbing-input allowance). The constraints prompt keeps the fail-closed rule: 'if a step could not be performed say so plainly and fail that criterion rather than assuming it passed.' AUTH LEG: not applicable; app_context.md lines 8-10 'Accounts: None. The app has no sign-in' and instruction.md 'without signing in'. IN-DIMENSION GATE IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT: functional, polish and visual prompt.md line 5 are identical: 'Global browser gate: before scoring, confirm in the live browser that the application loads from http://localhost:3000 without a fatal browser error and that text typed into the code editor appears in it. External font, script or CDN asset requests are allowed. If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension.' That is a hard zero, not partial credit; visual line 9 keeps it consistent ('Apart from a failed global browser gate, 0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all'). NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT: a case-insensitive search of task/tests for 'same-origin'/'cross-origin' returns nothing; all five prompts and app_context.md line 32 explicitly allow external font, script and CDN requests; task.toml has network_mode = "public" for environment and verifier; integration.md line 5 tells the builder external assets are allowed. BROKEN-APP PROBES: (a) blank or error page fails render; (b) static page with a non-typable editor mock fails render; (c) typable custom editor with browser-only saving passes render but fails cw_shared_saved_record, reward 0; (d) textarea or CodeMirror editor fails cw_custom_document_surface. I found no weak app that reaches the scored suite as a blank or static shell. CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBES: canvas or SVG editors are named as passing and app_context line 29 tells the judge to read canvas text from screenshots; a hidden plumbing textarea is allowed in both the brief and the criterion; an app that loads CDN assets is not failed; the gate types one plain word, which no auto-indent or bracket handling alters; overview.md allows a draft that starts with a small example and the gate only needs the word to appear. I found no conforming alternative that the gate text fails. MEASURED EVIDENCE: scripted golden on the previous commit's bytes reports cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing true (results/runtime.json), cw_custom_document_surface true (results/polish.json) and cw_shared_saved_record true (results/persist-before.json); the hashes I recomputed from git objects for run_golden.sh, tests/smoke.cjs, tests/persist.cjs, results/runtime.json, persist-before.json, persist-after.json, restart.json and editor.json equal the index. The hosted Oracle gates file hashes to the indexed 5b001eb8... and shows both constraints criteria passed by the configured judge, but its render criterion was the older cw_authored_custom_editor_run, not the current load-and-type criterion. WHY RISK IS TRUE: (1) no configured judge has run the current render gate criterion or the three reworded in-dimension gates on these bytes, so judge behaviour on the current gate wording is unmeasured; scripted Playwright is not the judge. (2) The indexed hash 617e450f... for run-6e537d14.../verifier/gates/reward-details.json could not be reproduced: the committed blob hashes to 402c78d0... (LF) and e85e3d85... (CRLF). (3) During this review the shared working tree was switched from task/colderwater-editor-strict to task/hireops-live-desk by someone else, which removed the tracked evidence files from disk (qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict now holds only build.log and restart.log; the run-outputs paths are gone), so every evidence hash above was taken from git objects of commit 4b3bef67 rather than from working-tree bytes. NOTES, not failures: (N1) the scored in-dimension gate has no server-backing leg although the skill text says 'plus auth and server-backing legs when the app has them'. The template's own scored gate has none either (only sign-in and populated content, which this app lacks), the backing leg is carried by the constraints gate that must pass before any scored judge runs, and repeating a save and storage-clear round trip in three more judges would add workload; I could build no app that gains credit from the omission. (N2) cw_custom_document_surface says the 'displayed source text' must not live in a textarea; a canvas editor that mirrors the full source into a visually hidden textarea for accessibility is not 'what shows the source to the user' and should pass by the wording, but a judge could misread it. This is a wording-robustness point owned by the criterion-fairness rows.
